title: SMB: Eliminate "[transact continuation]
description:
Changes:
1. Don't display "Data: %u of %u" if tdc is 0 in the Packet List.
2. Don't display "Bytes until TDC" if tdc is zero in the
   Packet Detail.
3. Eliminate "[transact continuation] because there is no
   straightforward way to determine if it's a continuation
   packet.
